lines: That broken bridge in the GTA 6 trailer? It's real.
That BROKEN BRIDGE in the GTA 6 trailer? It's REAL.
Come on. Nobody builds half a bridge.
Come on. Nobody builds HALF a bridge.
Real or game? A train that rode across the sea, all the way to Key West.
REAL or GAME? A TRAIN that rode across the SEA, all the way to KEY WEST.
Real. In 1912, the tracks ran more than a hundred miles out over open water.
REAL. In 1912, the tracks ran more than 100 MILES out over OPEN WATER.
A railroad boss with deep pockets. It took seven years, and people called it the eighth wonder of the world.
A railroad boss with DEEP POCKETS. It took SEVEN YEARS, and people called it the EIGHTH WONDER of the world.
So why does that bridge look broken?
So why does that bridge look BROKEN?
Bahia Honda had the deepest channel on the route, so they built giant steel frames called trusses.
BAHIA HONDA had the DEEPEST channel on the route, so they built giant STEEL frames called TRUSSES.
Then, in 1935, a hurricane ended the railroad.
Then, in 1935, a HURRICANE ended the railroad.
Real or game? Cars driving on the roof of a train bridge.
REAL or GAME? CARS driving on the ROOF of a TRAIN BRIDGE.
Real! In 1938 they paved right over the top of the trusses. You drove sixty-five feet above the sea.
REAL! In 1938 they PAVED right over the TOP of the trusses. You drove SIXTY-FIVE FEET above the sea.
My palms are sweating just hearing that.
My PALMS are SWEATING just hearing that.
A new bridge took over in 1972, and pieces of the old one were cut out so boats could pass safely.
A NEW bridge took over in 1972, and PIECES of the old one were CUT OUT so boats could pass SAFELY.
So the broken bridge in GTA 6...
So the BROKEN BRIDGE in GTA 6...
Is a real, hundred-year-old wonder. And you can still walk on part of it.
Is a REAL, HUNDRED-YEAR-OLD WONDER. And you can still WALK on part of it.
